summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: Add codex-cli/gpt-6-luna fallback to Heyasa, Koru and Supervisor after direct codex API rate limits, preserving explicit allowlists and existing failover.

delivery.outcome: Make the already-enabled Codex CLI subscription transport eligible as a GPT-6 Luna fallback for Heyasa command and decision-routing, Koru DSL and queue execution, and Supervisor assessment after direct Codex API limits.
nonGoals: Do not alter credentials, provider account limits, systemd settings, or consumer repositories.
Do not bypass an explicit SUBLLM_PROVIDER_ORDER allowlist or invoke Codex CLI when disabled.
Do not change model selection for unrelated application routes.

components.name: SubLLM route policy and routing regression tests

architecture.decision: Add a route-specific codex-cli/gpt-6-luna candidate to Heyasa, Koru and Supervisor routes so normal bounded provider failover can use the authenticated local CLI after a direct API limit. Preserve explicit operator allowlists and keep the existing downstream fallback candidates.
architecture.rollback: Revert the exact route candidates and focused regression cases through the protected publication lifecycle.

validation.evidence: Resolver returns the exact codex-cli/gpt-6-luna candidate for each affected Heyasa, Koru and Supervisor role and preserves the existing codex/gpt-6-luna route.
Default policy orders the CLI fallback before Ollama after the direct Codex candidate; an explicit allowlist that omits codex-cli remains authoritative.
Offline regression cases exercise route resolution and fail-closed provider exclusion without network or credentials.
Record exact output and exit codes; protected OneDev and independent Validator must approve the exact head before merge.

commands: one bounded live SubLLM canary through the protected runtime deployment
validation.evidence: A fresh read of the usage ledger records codex-cli/gpt-6-luna for the unique canary request. Runtime restart/deploy requires its protected deployment binding and independent acceptance readback.
